pairs.subject: platform-extension-release-ladder
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/review/Layer1.tsx:1 The review page is an operator-only session review surface in the desktop console that reads the local daemon's session record, not a viewer extension running in the streaming platform's player. A case-insensitive search of apps/console for Twitch.ext, onAuthorized, pubsub and extension_jwt found no hits, so the ladder's precondition does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/review/Moderation.tsx:1 This is the operator's moderation review of past sessions, not a queue where a streamer approves content viewers submitted through an extension.

pairs.subject: platform-extension-release-ladder
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/shell/Shell.tsx:1 This 'shell' is the operator console's page chrome and client router. It is not a reviewed extension shell that renders a design document in viewers' players. A search of apps/console for Twitch.ext, onAuthorized, pubsub and extension_jwt found nothing, so the subject was matched on the token 'shell' alone.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/shell/Shell.tsx:2 Pages plug in through a code-level PageRegistry for a desktop operator app. There is no viewer-facing design document and no platform review to work around.

pairs.subject: platform-extension-release-ladder
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:25 The build packages a Tauri desktop app whose only declared hosts are the local daemon at 127.0.0.1:7717. It builds no platform extension bundle for submission and review. A search of apps/console for Twitch.ext, onAuthorized, pubsub and extension_jwt found no hits.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/package.json:8 This bundle check is a desktop app size budget. No platform reviewer reads this bundle.
apps/console/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:5 The CSP host list belongs to a desktop webview reaching a localhost daemon, not a per-version extension allowlist submitted for platform review.

pairs.registryProposal: Matching on the tokens 'shell', 'build', 'bundle', 'review' and 'panel' pulls this subject onto any web app with a build step or a review page. The subject's use_when could require platform-extension vocabulary before a context matches.
